message.content:
**Uno – Quick‑Start Rules** | Section | What you need to know | |---------|-----------------------| | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or whatever house rule you set). Points are earned by being the first to finish a round and by collecting the cards left in opponents’ hands. | | **Players** | 2–10 (standard deck). | | **Deck** | 108 cards: 4 colors (Red, Yellow, Green, Blue) × 25 cards each (one 0, two 1–9, two “Skip”, two “Reverse”, two “Draw Two”) + 4 “Wild” + 4 “Wild Draw Four”. | | **Setup** | • Shuffle the deck.
• Deal 7 cards to each player.
• Place the remaining cards face‑down to form the draw pile.
• Flip the top card of the draw pile to start the discard pile. If it’s a special card, apply its effect immediately (e.g., if it’s a “Draw Two”, the first player draws two cards and loses a turn). | | **Turn Order** | Players sit in a circle. The first player is the one to the left of the dealer. Turn order moves clockwise unless a “Reverse” card changes direction. | | **Playing a Card** | On your turn you may play **one** card that matches either the **color** or the **number/symbol** of the top card on the discard pile. If you have no playable card, you must draw one from the draw pile. If that card is playable, you may play it immediately; otherwise, your turn ends. | | **Special Cards** | 1. **Skip** – Next player loses their turn.
2. **Reverse** – Changes play direction.
3. **Draw Two** – Next player draws two cards and loses a turn.
4. **Wild** – You choose the new color.
5. **Wild Draw Four** – You choose the new color; next player draws four cards and loses a turn. (Can only be played if you have no other playable card; otherwise, you can be challenged.) | | **Calling “UNO”** | When you play your **second‑to‑last** card (i.e., you have one card left), you must shout “UNO!” before the next player takes their turn. If you forget and another player catches you, you must draw two penalty cards. | | **Winning a Round** | The round ends when a player discards their last card. That player scores points equal to the sum of the values of all cards still held by the other players: numbers = face value, Skip/Reverse/Draw Two = 20 points each, Wild/Wild Draw Four = 50 points each. | | **Winning the Game** | First player to reach 500 points (or the agreed target) wins. If you want a shorter game, lower the target or play a single round. | --- ### Quick Tips - **Keep an eye on the color** – If you’re about to run out of cards, try to keep a Wild or Wild Draw Four in reserve. - **Use “Reverse” strategically** – In a 2‑player game it acts like a “Skip”; in larger games it can change the flow. - **Challenge a “Wild Draw Four”** – If you suspect the player had a playable card, you can challenge. If they were wrong, they draw 4 cards; if they were right, you draw 6 cards. - **Play defensively** – If you’re close to winning, avoid playing a card that lets the next player draw or skip. Enjoy the fast‑paced, colorful fun of Uno!
